simulator.burst_rule: fixed-size and independent of event onset, offset, environment transitions, and labels
simulator.rate_units: expected counts per second before burst encoding
simulator.rate_interpretation: rates are simulation parameters for independent Poisson counts, not physical detector calibration

strata.per_episode_override: evaluator determinacy from surviving evidence overrides family default

comparison_rule.method: paired bootstrap confidence interval for baseline-minus-Protama on oriented metrics

threshold_justifications.determinate_event_accuracy_min: 0.95 requires near-ceiling event identification while allowing a small finite-sample error margin.
threshold_justifications.epistemic_ambiguous_abstention_accuracy_: 0.95 requires reliable abstention on evidence-insufficient episodes rather than forced guesses.
threshold_justifications.capacity_aware_eviction_abstention_accur: 0.95 requires the bounded-memory policy to recognize when eviction removes required evidence.
threshold_justifications.evidence_span_iou_min: 0.80 requires temporal localization to substantially overlap the evaluator span.
threshold_justifications.near_miss_false_positive_rate_max: 0.05 limits false commitments on structurally similar but invalid episodes.
threshold_justifications.snapshot_replay_agreement_min: 1.0 ensures serialized state replay is exact, not approximate.
threshold_justifications.cross_episode_leakage_max: 0.0 forbids evaluation information from carrying across episode boundaries.

label_rule.development_pass: at least 100 determinate and 100 epistemic episodes, complete baseline suite, all trial records, independent strata thresholds, and all zero-tolerance conditions pass
label_rule.gate_pass: development-pass plus all preregistered confidence-interval bounds and baseline comparison rules pass
label_rule.otherwise: development-fail or gate-fail according to the evaluated phase

adaptation_rule: Any configuration whose parameters or retained state change as a function of scored-episode outcomes constitutes development adaptation; it ends the run and requires a new freeze.

source_environment_contingency_table.construction: door and shielding markers are seeded independently of source family and published with episode records
